seed.tagline: Turn an Airtable base into a rulebook you own.
seed.description: Extracts every table, field, formula, description and record from an Airtable base into a rulebook, then derives everything from it: the Postgres schema, documentation, RuleSpeak, the explainer DAG, an Excel workbook and the browser rulebook editor. Re-pull it with effortless build -id and the rulebook follows the base.
seed.requiresInput: An Airtable base and read access to it

replacements.label: What should we call it?
replacements.description: Short lower-case project name (becomes the repository and database name)

replacements.label: Airtable base id
replacements.description: The base to extract, starting with 'app' (it is in the base's URL: airtable.com/appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/...).

replacements.label: Airtable personal access token
replacements.description: A token with schema and data read scope on that base. Used once for the extraction and not stored.

replacements.label: Which tables hold people?
replacements.description: The tables whose rows are people who sign in (users, staff, customers). Leave blank if none do.
